title: "Getting started"
author: "Mohamad Yassine"

## Requirements

- Python **3.10+**
- A webcam (for live modes)
- Tkinter (bundled with most Python installs; on Debian/Ubuntu: `sudo apt install python3-tk`)

## Install

### Linux / macOS

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mohamadysn/FaceGate.git
cd FaceGate
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### Windows

```bat
git clone https://github.com/mohamadysn/FaceGate.git
cd FaceGate
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

Optional training extras (ArcFace / RetinaFace remakes):

```bash
pip install -r requirements-train.txt
```

## Run the desktop app

```bash
cd eye-tracking
python app/launch.py
```

OS launchers (from `eye-tracking/app/`):

| OS | Launcher |
|----|----------|
| Linux | `FaceGate` |
| Windows | `FaceGate.bat` |
| macOS | `FaceGate.command` |

Install a Desktop / Start-menu shortcut:

```bash
cd eye-tracking
python app/install_desktop_shortcut.py
```

## Camera backends

| OS | OpenCV backend |
|----|----------------|
| Linux | V4L2 |
| Windows | DirectShow / MSMF |
| macOS | AVFoundation |

## Tests

```bash
cd eye-tracking
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```
